# SD Commencement Kickoff (Next Thursday)

- Signatures complete as of 9/7; all-day session planned for Thursday
- Philip attending in person; Matt available remotely if needed
- Meeting will shift focus to planned production: design progression, discipline coordination, utility provider touchpoints (SMUD, PG\&E, JCI)
- Matt flagged the session will push subconsultants to accelerate, with real-time feasibility conversations
- Whitney coordinating full run of show and agenda with Sam
  - Philip to flag any agenda items he wants covered

# Entitlements and COA Updates

- Jeremiah Zillig (building official) raised concern at Wednesday city meeting about consultant staff preparedness and turnaround times
  - Wants a more granular schedule; Whitney to follow up with him today
  - Coordinate with Cosphere before releasing detailed schedule to Jeremiah; Whitney to send Charlie/Josh a note (copying Matt and Philip) asking for approval first
- Revised COA received last Friday; key changes around fire and Caltrans conditions
  - Caltrans now requiring Sunrise Interchange analysis in addition to Zinfandel, with cost and mitigation implications still TBD
  - Caltrans agreed to allow project to proceed through entitlements (unusual), but subsequent analysis is required
  - College Peer pushing back on the condition; city and College Peer in active negotiation
- Phased building permits: Jeremiah confirmed he will not require civil plan approval before issuing partial underground/foundation permits
  - Will informally check with Albert and Darcy, then issue phased permits to allow construction to start ahead of site civil approval
  - Whitney treating this as a contingency, not banking on it in the current schedule

# Schedule Status

- Current milestone dates (from executed agreement 9/7):
  - 100% SD package: 11/13
  - Site improvement plan submission: 12/18 (one month after SD handoff to Wood Rodgers)
  - 50% DDs: 12/25; 100% DDs: 2/12
  - Rough grading package: \~3 weeks after SD start
  - Mass grading permit issuance: 11/17 (review 15-25 days, to confirm with Albert)
  - Site improvement plan approval: 1/22; first building permit: 1/29
  - Groundbreaking: targeting early January (driven by SSHCP approval and City Council notice to proceed \~12/11)
- Philip’s key dependency: civil plans approved before first building permit pull; back-calculating from that date
- Whitney to send Philip the updated schedule once COA revisions are incorporated

# Next Steps

- **Email Charlie and Josh re: schedule release to Jeremiah** (Whitney)

  Copy Matt and Philip; ask Charlie to approve before sending any further schedule detail to Jeremiah.
- **Update schedule to reflect latest COA revisions, then send to Philip for review** (Whitney)

  Philip to confirm Wood Rodgers' dates and durations are accurate before the Thursday all-day session.
- **Flag agenda items for Thursday's all-day session** (Philip)
